title: 找到事实，再核对选项
goal: 先用问题里的关键词定位，再核对人物、时间、地点和数量。
pitfall: 原文里出现过的词不一定就是答案；它必须回答当前的问题。

texts.text:
LIBRARY HELPERS WANTED
Our school library needs four helpers for the next six weeks. Helpers put returned books on the right shelves and help younger students find books. They do not need to work at the front desk. The work is on Tuesdays and Thursdays, from 4:10 to 4:40 p.m. If you can only come on one of those days, you can still apply. Please give a short note to Ms Chen in Room 203 by Friday. Tell her which day you can come and why you would like to help. There is no online form.
items: How many helpers does the library need?
Four
Six
Two
needs four helpers
six 指持续六周，不是人数。
two 是每周安排的工作日数量，不是人数。
Which task will the helpers do?
Put returned books on shelves
Work at the front desk
Sell books to students
put returned books on the right shelves
原文明说不需要在前台工作。
原文没有售书任务。
When does the work finish each day?
At 4:40 p.m.
At 4:10 p.m.
At 4:30 p.m.
from 4:10 to 4:40 p.m.
4:10 是开始时间。
原文没有 4:30 这个时间。
Can a student apply if they are free only on Thursdays?
Yes, one day is enough
No, both days are required
Only after the six weeks
If you can only come on one of those days, you can still apply.
原文允许只来其中一天。
六周是工作持续时间，不是申请等待时间。
Who should receive the note?
Ms Chen
A younger student
The front-desk helper
give a short note to Ms Chen
低年级学生是帮助对象。
原文没有让前台工作人员收申请。
What should the note include?
The day the student can come
An online form number
A list of books to buy
Tell her which day you can come
没有线上表格，也就没有表格编号要求。
原文没有购书清单要求。

texts.text:
A NEW LUNCH CLUB
A lunch club will begin in Room 108 next Wednesday. Students can bring their own lunch and eat together while learning simple ways to reduce food waste. The first meeting starts at 12:20 and ends at 12:50. Mr Gao will show students how to plan a small meal. The school will provide drinking water, but not food. Students do not need to sign up. Please bring a lunch box and a spoon. The club will meet every Wednesday for a month. After that, members will decide whether to continue.
items: Where will the club meet?
In Room 108
In Room 203
In the library
begin in Room 108
203 不在这则通知里。
通知没有说在图书馆见面。
What is the main learning focus?
Reducing food waste
Buying more food
Cooking a large dinner
ways to reduce food waste
没有要求购买更多食物。
示范的是 small meal，不是大餐。
How long is the first meeting?
Thirty minutes
Twenty minutes
Fifty minutes
starts at 12:20 and ends at 12:50
12:20 是起始钟点，不是持续二十分钟。
12:50 是结束钟点，不是持续五十分钟。
What will the school provide?
Drinking water
Lunch
Spoons
provide drinking water, but not food
but not food 排除了提供午餐。
spoon 是学生需要自带的物品。
Do students have to sign up?
No
Yes, by Tuesday
Yes, online
Students do not need to sign up.
通知没有周二截止报名的要求。
通知明确不用报名，没有线上登记要求。
Who will decide whether the club continues after a month?
The members
Mr Gao alone
The library helpers
members will decide whether to continue
Mr Gao 负责示范，原文没有说由他独自决定。
图书馆助手与这则通知无关。

title: 推断要有原文撑住
goal: 把人物的动作和处境连起来，只推断原文能够支持的意思。
pitfall: 推断不是自由猜测。选项不能比原文多走一大步。

texts.text:
On the morning of the class picnic, Ben opened his bag for the third time. Two water bottles, a raincoat and a small first-aid kit were inside. His friend Mia laughed. 'We are only going to the park.'
At the park, the sun disappeared behind dark clouds. A few students had no coats. Ben opened his raincoat and held it above their notebooks while they packed. Later, Mia cut her finger on a sharp piece of paper. Ben quietly handed her a plaster.
On the bus home, Mia looked at Ben's almost empty bag. 'Next time,' she said, 'will you help me pack mine?' Ben smiled.
items: Why does Ben check his bag several times?
He wants to be prepared
He has lost the picnic tickets
He wants to carry less water
Two water bottles, a raincoat and a small first-aid kit
原文没有丢票这件事。
准备两瓶水不能支持他想少带水。
How does Mia first feel about Ben's bag?
She thinks he has packed more than necessary
She is angry that he took her things
She is worried about his tickets
We are only going to the park.
没有证据表明 Ben 拿了她的东西。
文中没有提到票。
What does the raincoat protect at the park?
The students' notebooks
The bus seats
The picnic food
held it above their notebooks
此时还在公园，没有保护车座的情节。
文中明确是 notebooks，不是食物。
Why is the plaster useful?
Mia has cut her finger
Ben has broken his bag
A student has wet shoes
Mia cut her finger on a sharp piece of paper
bag 没有损坏，创可贴也不是用来修包。
鞋湿并非这里使用创可贴的原因。
What does Mia's final question suggest?
She now values Ben's preparation
She wants Ben to carry every bag
She dislikes picnics now
will you help me pack mine?
她只请求帮自己整理，没有要求拿所有人的包。
文中没有说她不喜欢野餐。
Which description of Ben is best supported?
Careful and helpful
Forgetful and impatient
Loud and careless
Ben quietly handed her a plaster.
反复检查和随时提供帮助不支持健忘、不耐烦。
quietly 以及周到准备都不支持吵闹、粗心。

texts.text:
The school art wall had a new rule: every class could use one square for a picture about their community. Nina wanted to paint the tall buildings near her home. Her grandfather suggested the small shoe repair shop beside them. 'Nobody notices that place,' Nina said.
That afternoon, she watched the shop from a bench. A delivery worker brought in a broken bag strap. A child waited while the owner repaired a school shoe. An older woman stopped just to talk. Each person left smiling.
The next day, Nina sketched the little shop. She left space around the door for the people who used it. When her grandfather saw the picture, he did not ask why she had changed her plan. He simply smiled.
items: What does Nina first plan to paint?
The tall buildings
The repair shop
The school gate
Nina wanted to paint the tall buildings near her home.
修鞋店是祖父的建议，不是她最初的打算。
学校门口没有出现在计划中。
Why does Nina sit on the bench?
To observe the repair shop
To wait for her delivery
To repair her own shoe
she watched the shop from a bench
她没有等待自己的快递。
送去修鞋的是另一个孩子。
What can we infer about the shop?
It matters to different people nearby
It repairs only school shoes
It is always empty
A delivery worker ... A child ... An older woman
还修包带，所以不只修学生鞋。
接连出现的顾客说明店里并非总是空的。
Why does Nina leave space around the door in her picture?
To include the people connected with the shop
To hide the shop's sign
To draw more tall buildings later
space around the door for the people who used it
原文明确是为人物留空间，不是隐藏招牌。
没有说之后补画高楼。
What has Nina probably learned?
An ordinary place can be important
Only large buildings are worth painting
Art should never include people
Each person left smiling.
她最后转画小店，否定了只有大楼值得画。
她特意为人们留空间。
Why does the grandfather probably smile at the end?
He understands that Nina has seen the shop's value
He wants her to remove the people
He thinks the picture is about a different city
he did not ask why she had changed her plan
没有要求她删掉人物。
没有异地城市的线索。

title: 抓住主旨，不被一个细节带走
goal: 比较开头、变化和结尾，找出能覆盖全文的主题。
pitfall: 选项即使包含真实细节，若只能概括一句话，也不够概括全文。

texts.text:
Our class used to collect old batteries in a cardboard box. We put up a bright poster, but the box stayed almost empty. Then we asked classmates why they did not use it. Some did not know where it was. Others were unsure which batteries were safe to put inside.
We moved the box next to the office, added a clear label and asked a teacher to check it each week. We also explained that damaged batteries should be handed directly to an adult. In the next month, more students joined in.
The project taught us that a good idea needs a clear, safe way to take part. A colourful poster can attract attention, but careful planning turns attention into action.
items: What problem did the class have at first?
Few students used the collection box
The box was too full
The office refused to help
the box stayed almost empty
almost empty 与太满相反。
文中没有办公室拒绝协助的情节。
What did classmates say they were unsure about?
Which batteries could safely go in
How to paint the poster
When the school opened
unsure which batteries were safe to put inside
海报绘画不是同学提出的问题。
学校开门时间与收集活动无关。
Who should receive damaged batteries?
An adult
A younger student
Any visitor
damaged batteries should be handed directly to an adult
原文指定交给成人，不是低年级学生。
并非交给任何来访者。
Why did more students join later?
The class made participation clearer and safer
The class stopped collecting batteries
The poster became larger
a clear label ... a teacher to check it each week
后文仍在收集，没有停止。
原文没有海报变大的信息。
Which title best covers the passage?
A Good Idea Needs a Clear Plan
How to Draw a Bright Poster
A Visit to the School Office
careful planning turns attention into action
海报只是开头的一个细节，无法覆盖改进过程。
办公室只是收集箱的新位置，不是全文主题。
What is the writer's main purpose?
To share a lesson from improving a project
To sell a kind of battery
To list every school office rule
The project taught us that a good idea needs a clear, safe way to take part.
全文没有商品或销售意图。
只涉及项目参与方式，不是办公室规章清单。

texts.text:
When our school started a quiet reading break, I thought everyone would need the same book. Our teacher suggested something different. Each person could choose a text, but we would all read for fifteen minutes without phones.
During the first week, Leo read a guide to birds. Mia brought a short story, and I chose a book about bridges. At the end of the week, we each shared one question. Leo wondered why some birds travelled so far. Mia asked whether the main character had made the right choice. I wanted to know how a bridge could stand without a support in the middle.
We had read different things, yet the break gave us a shared habit: making time to read and becoming curious about what we found.
items: What does the writer first expect?
Everyone will read the same book
The break will last an hour
Phones will be required
I thought everyone would need the same book.
原文规定十五分钟，不是一小时。
without phones 表明不使用手机。
How long is the reading time?
Fifteen minutes
Five minutes
Fifty minutes
read for fifteen minutes
five 不符合原文数字。
fifty 与 fifteen 不同，不能混淆。
What does Leo read?
A guide to birds
A book about bridges
A short story
Leo read a guide to birds.
关于桥的书是作者选的。
短篇故事是 Mia 带来的。
What do students share at the end of the week?
One question each
A phone message each
The same answer
we each shared one question
活动明确不使用手机，分享的是问题。
大家提出不同问题，没有统一答案要求。
Which sentence best expresses the main idea?
Different books can help build a shared reading habit
Every student should read only stories
Questions make reading a waste of time
different things ... a shared habit
材料包括鸟类和桥梁，远不只有故事。
结尾赞同好奇和提问，不认为是浪费时间。
How does the writer feel about the break by the end?
Positive about the habit it creates
Certain that it should stop
Angry that books are different
making time to read and becoming curious
结尾强调好处，没有要求停止。
不同读物反而带来共同习惯，不是愤怒原因。
